visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Replace a table layout with grid
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A table is used to place the label and the value side by side. Use a grid with two columns. The text must stay in the same order.

solution.explanation: A table is for data that has rows and columns by meaning. Label and value pairs are layout, and a grid does that without table markup, and it can change shape for different screens.
